title: Choose, stop and restore
promptMarkdown: A training run logs epochs1–8 with validation losses(.80,.62,.55,.56,.54,.55,.56,.53) and steadily falling training loss. Use this rule: an improvement must be strictly more than0.005 below the best saved validation loss; patience2 consecutive non-improvements; earliest accepted best wins ties. Start best=∞. Which epochs are saved, when does training stop, and which state is evaluated on test? Explain why epoch 8 is unavailable under this run and why holding a pointer to a mutable model is an implementation bug.
hintLadder: Track best loss and consecutive failures separately.
Reset patience only after an accepted improvement.
Distinguish the best saved state from the final visited state.
